_b3l3th_: On the way to M-F19, Emil Blth tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister and Emil Blth both swear they saw a ghost at Verdel Ridge. Each says the other screamed first.
amanatidis511: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram Amanatidis arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Two shots, one miss. The second found Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska, grazed. Bram Amanatidis cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Bram Amanatidis fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F16. Gideon Nkmcnamee was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Bram Amanatidis did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Bram Amanatidis and Teodor "Hollow" Aim cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Leopold "Tin" Jake of the Concord shouted across the wire at the Bone Quarry, asking for the football scores from home. Bram Amanatidis of the Hegemony shouted them back. Some of them were even true.
Bram Amanatidis tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.

A bullet went into Bram Amanatidis's chest just under the heart at Q-F16. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Marek Brycetom of the Concord (@brycetom03). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Bram Amanatidis fell at Q-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Marek Brycetom of the Concord (@brycetom03).
The House of Amanatidis sent another. Oskar Amanatidis, brother of Bram Amanatidis, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At Q-F16 they left Oskar Amanatidis behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Marek Brycetom of the Concord (@brycetom03).
Rafael "Mud" Amanatidis came to the front because his father Oskar Amanatidis never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.

Rafael "Mud" Amanatidis took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at Q-F16, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname of the Concord (@somebodynamednile). Rafael "Mud" Amanatidis was killed on watch at Q-F16. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname of the Concord (@somebodynamednile).
The papers connected Hugo Amanatidis to Rafael "Mud" Amanatidis. The men took longer to learn Hugo Amanatidis's own habits, but they made the effort.
Hugo saved Clement Redactedword's last cigarette from a falling sandbag. Clement Redactedword did not say thanks, but kept the stub.
catank75: The new runner gave his name as Quentin Catank. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Quentin Catank wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Quentin Catank began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. After the loss of Grey Mill, Quentin Catank helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Quentin Catank polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Quentin Catank kept watch so that Norbert Cipowski could sleep. Then Norbert kept watch so that Quentin could. Neither slept.
A bullet found Quentin Catank at Q-F3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67).
Quentin Catank lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Quentin Catank waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Quentin Catank no longer needed it.
Casimir Catank took the same post at Q-F3 where Quentin Catank stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Casimir Catank was hit twice at Q-F3, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Cyril Bangnbreach of the Hegemony (@bangnbreach). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Casimir Catank fell at Q-F3 and never moved again. Shot by Cyril Bangnbreach of the Hegemony (@bangnbreach).
The House of Catank sent Pavel Catank after Casimir Catank. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Zeno "Owl" Dorno taught Pavel how to tie a perfect knot. Pavel used it to tie Pavel boots together by mistake.
d5olo2010: Casimir Olo arrived with the Day 8 draft, carrying a frozen apple and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Casimir Olo said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.

Casimir Olo was carrying water up to S-S4 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Casimir Olo did not. Shot by Henrik Guacamole of the Concord (@guacamole_1354). The bearers reached Casimir Olo at S-S4 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Henrik Guacamole of the Concord (@guacamole_1354).
Rafael "Parson" Olo took the same post at S-S4 where Casimir Olo stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Rafael "Parson" Olo carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters. Rafael "Parson" Olo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 511. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Rafael "Parson" Olo let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Rafael "Parson" Olo carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes kept watch so that Rafael "Parson" Olo could sleep. Then Parson kept watch so that Mole could. Neither slept.
Rafael "Parson" Olo raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Quentin The of the Concord (@noah_the_0ne).
The medic looked at Rafael "Parson" Olo's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-S4. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

Rafael "Parson" Olo borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Edmund "Ash" Yer was badly wounded. A burst of machine-gun fire caught Rafael "Parson" Olo in the open at S-S4. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Marek Boi of the Concord (@oreo_boi_5000). Rafael "Parson" Olo looked over the parapet at S-S4 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Marek Boi of the Concord (@oreo_boi_5000).
Oskar Olo had heard about Rafael "Parson" Olo's courage. At S-S4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A bullet went into Oskar Olo's chest just under the heart at S-S4. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Emil Military of the Concord (@the_john_military). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Oskar Olo fell at S-S4 and never moved again. Shot by Emil Military of the Concord (@the_john_military).
The papers say Edmund "Doc" Olo. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Oskar Olo's eyes. Nobody in S-S4 argues.
Edmund reached up to fix a sandbag at S-S4 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Florian Khattabka of the Concord (@khattabka_).
deer.95252304: In Tannenfeld, Albin Deer was a ferryman. In Q-F20, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a ferryman again.

Albin Deer's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. Albin Deer walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Albin Deer gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Albin Deer opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Konrad "Doc" Mekli held the mirror while Albin Deer shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
A second spoon disappeared. Albin Deer searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Albin Deer's ear at Q-F20 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Pavel Huntertheyan of the Concord (@huntertheyankee).

The wound on Albin Deer's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Albin Deer got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.

Albin lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing. A thin letter reached Albin. Only five lines long, and Albin knew every one of them by heart before supper.
emmettoftheknox: On the way to S-S10, Ulrich Emmettofthek tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Ulrich Emmettofthek (Concord) and Wendel Roma (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Hill 304. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.

Ulrich Emmettofthek has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Emmettofthek. Ulrich Emmettofthek read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob of the Hegemony and Ulrich Emmettofthek of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Hanging Bridge for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Ulrich Emmettofthek spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Ulrich Emmettofthek looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Ulrich Emmettofthek had just lit a cigarette at S-S10 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Quentin Nieuwenhuis of the Hegemony (@gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_). Ulrich Emmettofthek got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 423. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Ulrich Emmettofthek read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Ulrich Emmettofthek took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-S10, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921). Ulrich Emmettofthek was killed at S-S10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921).
Pavel Emmettofthek came to the front because his father Ulrich Emmettofthek never came home. He carries a child's drawing of a horse.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Pavel Emmettofthek worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Pavel Emmettofthek helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.

Pavel Emmettofthek was hit through the chest at S-S10. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Silas "Mole" Darian of the Hegemony (@darian_d_16). Pavel Emmettofthek stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-S10. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Silas "Mole" Darian of the Hegemony (@darian_d_16).
Benedikt Emmettofthek had heard about Pavel Emmettofthek's courage. At S-S10, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A round went through Benedikt Emmettofthek's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999).

Benedikt Emmettofthek was hit through the stomach at S-S10. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc of the Hegemony (@sterlinglance_). Benedikt Emmettofthek was hit at S-S10 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc of the Hegemony (@sterlinglance_).
The House of Emmettofthek sent another. Quentin "Crow" Emmettofthek, older brother of Benedikt Emmettofthek, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A bullet went through Quentin's sleeve at S-S10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Otto Aegisdirecti of the Hegemony (@aegisdirectivee).
gunpla_monster: Roland Monster took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

During a lull at Sorrow Copse, Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac called across from the Concord line. Roland Monster answered from the Hegemony side with a convincing imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Roland Monster looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet went through Roland Monster's sleeve at S-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).

Roland Monster's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. A letter from home found Roland Monster before the night shift. Roland Monster folded it small and kept it close.

Roland Monster spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Roland Monster folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
There was never a bed for Roland Monster, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F7 on his own feet.
Roland Monster tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Listening post, three in the morning. Roland Monster heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards.
A round went through the rim of Roland Monster's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626).

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Roland Monster is whole again, or near enough for the line. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Roland Monster helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Roland Monster made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Roland Monster is number 156. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-F7 changed before the cheering ended. Roland Monster shouldered another load.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Roland Monster said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
A parcel from home held a comb. Roland Monster has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Wiring party. Roland Monster held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F7, and everyone came back.
Roland Monster saved the last of the sugar for Bram Roma's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Bram's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
The Concord raiders came over at S-F7 in the middle of the night. Roland Monster met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).
The papers say Cyril "Lucky" Monster. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Roland Monster's eyes. Nobody in S-F7 argues.
Cyril "Lucky" Monster was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Bram Roma read a page of Cyril "Lucky" Monster's diary by accident. Bram Roma did not tell, but was kinder for a week.
heru.edhi: On Day 9 Edmund Edhi took a post at T-F22 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He writes everything down in a tiny notebook, and the men liked him for it.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Edmund Edhi looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Edmund Edhi and Albin Ilhanrae cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Edmund Edhi stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Edmund Edhi tried to remember the price of a loaf in Greyhallow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

Edmund Edhi was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F22. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Yann Mustakimabdu of the Hegemony (@mustakimabdulwahab93).
Edmund Edhi is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Edmund Edhi as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Edmund Edhi had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Zeno Ashleyjsona was grazed.
Edmund Edhi has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
Edmund drew the street leading to Greyhallow. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
jarvisben: Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-R12. Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben fired at the last man to run. Jakub Fts was grazed. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben aimed a step ahead and fired: Roland "Button" Alex, grazed. Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman was grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben fired, and Clement "Lucky" Johnrant was grazed.
Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben (Hegemony) watched Karel Dustinviper (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Calvary Farm, and held fire until both were gone.
Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in S-R12. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Rematch. Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben lost everything he won, plus a cracked shaving mirror. The whole dugout watched.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben won back a cracked shaving mirror and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Emil started drawing a map of his village on the dugout wall with a piece of charcoal. He started with the church.
joshbanaka: Nobody asked Florian Joshbanaka why he came. Nobody in R-R14 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Florian Joshbanaka did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Florian Joshbanaka caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Florian Joshbanaka during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A rat stole Florian Joshbanaka's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Florian Joshbanaka added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R14 and grazed Florian Joshbanaka's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Florian Joshbanaka is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Florian Joshbanaka fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr was grazed. Florian Joshbanaka ate breakfast without a word.

Florian Joshbanaka fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Dorian Marceloferna was badly wounded. Florian Joshbanaka had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Bastian Idkvariable was badly wounded.
Florian fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.
kechy_ali09: Arno Ali reached R-S8 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Arno Ali's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A newspaper reached Arno Ali with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home reached Arno Ali before dusk. Arno Ali read it twice and slept a little easier.
Arno Ali spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A letter from home reached Arno Ali before dusk. Arno Ali read it twice and slept a little easier.
Someone asked Arno Ali to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.

Arno Ali found an old map of the Hanging Bridge from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. A letter from home reached Arno Ali before dusk. Arno Ali read it twice and slept a little easier.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno Ali watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Arno Ali felt a hard tug at his hip at R-S8. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Cyril "Spark" Jesus of the Concord (@topgun_jesus). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno Ali is number 380. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Arno Ali did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Arno Ali is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

Arno Ali was hit through the stomach at R-S8. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Walter Markdavis of the Concord (@markdavis76239). Arno Ali was killed on watch at R-S8. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Walter Markdavis of the Concord (@markdavis76239).
Another member of the House of Ali reached the line: Severin Ali. He asked where Arno Ali had slept, then chose a different corner.
A bullet clipped Severin Ali's helmet at R-S8 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Cyril "Mud" Sann of the Concord (@senkoo_sann0).
Severin Ali returned to R-S8 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

Severin Ali was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-S8. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy of the Concord (@alierayyagiyanik). Severin Ali spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.
Severin Ali lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Severin spent the first night back at R-S8 not sleeping. He said the quiet was too loud.
keggaholic: Day 9. The corporal put Yann "Parson" Keggaholic beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Yann "Parson" Keggaholic wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Yann "Parson" Keggaholic was hit in the foot through his boot at Q-S6. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa of the Hegemony (@bannerlordsarp). A single shot at Q-S6. Yann "Parson" Keggaholic sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa of the Hegemony (@bannerlordsarp).

Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic put a child's drawing of a horse beside the bunk. Someone who had known Yann "Parson" Keggaholic helped clear the shelf without saying why. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-S6 with the rations. Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic ate while listening to the revised orders.

Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic was hit in the forearm at Q-S6. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Leopold Rags of the Hegemony (@good_ol_rags).
Three days with a bandage, and Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic is back at Q-S6. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Roland Eugeneous and Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

During a lull at the Sunken Road, Silas "Bones" Hunterplum called across from the Hegemony line. Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
A white dog ran between the lines at the Drowned Farm. Albin "Tin" Ringwraith (Hegemony) and Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic (Concord) both whistled for it. It chose neither.
khoi_nguyen6789: Nils "Lucky" Nguyen took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Nils "Lucky" Nguyen had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Zeno Ashleyjsona was badly wounded. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Nils "Lucky" Nguyen watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A bullet grazed Nils "Lucky" Nguyen's ribs at U-F1. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Norbert Kolor of the Hegemony (@kolor_o_vo).

A bullet went through Nils "Lucky" Nguyen's upper arm at U-F1 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Albin Welcometomem of the Hegemony (@welcometomemetown2.0). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Nils "Lucky" Nguyen fell at U-F1 and never moved again. Shot by Albin Welcometomem of the Hegemony (@welcometomemetown2.0).

The papers say Karel Nguyen. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Nils "Lucky" Nguyen's eyes. Nobody in U-F1 argues. Karel Nguyen became a sniper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Karel Nguyen tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at U-F1 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Nguyen. Karel Nguyen read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Karel Nguyen fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Nguyen. Karel Nguyen read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Karel Nguyen fought Ulrich Kolor in a trench no wider than a door. Karel Nguyen came home with Ulrich Kolor's cap badge. (@kolor_o_vo) The Hegemony sentry, Emil Ckrueger, shouted once. Karel Nguyen silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@ckrueger247) Karel Nguyen was the last raider out of the enemy trench, covering the others. The others made it home. Karel Nguyen did not.
Another member of the House of Nguyen reached the line: Otto "Spark" Nguyen. He asked where Karel Nguyen had slept, then chose a different corner.
Otto "Spark" Nguyen found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
A supply man offered Otto a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
mearsiecat: In Rosenau, Konrad Mearsiecat was a coal miner. In R-F3, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a coal miner again.
Konrad Mearsiecat borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.

Konrad Mearsiecat went out with the wiring party at R-F3. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F3. Konrad Mearsiecat has learned to walk bent double.
A rat stole Konrad Mearsiecat's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Konrad Mearsiecat fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Konrad Mearsiecat checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
Konrad Mearsiecat began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F3 they left Konrad Mearsiecat behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Otto Tyner of the Hegemony (@tyner_1776).
The House of Mearsiecat sent Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat after Konrad Mearsiecat. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. The clerk counted the names twice. Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat is number 261 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat helped stack spare sandbags at R-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
A round went through Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Rafael "Owl" Dooley of the Hegemony (@kaelan_dooley).
Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F3 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
The artist tried again while Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Albin Icespiceynod, now badly wounded.

The sergeant at R-F3 called out a range and a spot. Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat was the only one who hit it. Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt was grazed. Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Arno Cadendareal was badly wounded.
Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
Karel reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F3 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Benedikt Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424).
mr.unstoppable213: Ulrich Unstoppable told the sergeant he was a coal miner. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Ulrich Unstoppable fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bastian Nodrag, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

A supply man offered Ulrich Unstoppable a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Ulrich Unstoppable shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Ulrich Unstoppable coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
Ulrich Unstoppable had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Quentin Joshgentile crossed it, Ulrich Unstoppable fired. Quentin Joshgentile was badly wounded.
On dawn watch at R-F3, Ulrich Unstoppable fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Otto Geronimoleys, now gravely wounded.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Ulrich Unstoppable tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through an operatic duet nobody can translate, spoiling the best part.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Ulrich Unstoppable let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Ulrich Unstoppable passed the gramophone to the next section with a note about the screw. By evening, an operatic duet nobody can translate could be heard faintly through the wall. The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich Unstoppable is number 277 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Ulrich Unstoppable shouldered another load.
Ulrich Unstoppable lost a boot in the trench. Severin Latsch found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Ulrich Unstoppable fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Viktor Imposterdonu was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Ulrich Unstoppable was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Norbert Tsepnidiss was grazed.
Ulrich Unstoppable pulled Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Ulrich Unstoppable aimed a step ahead and fired: Gideon Giannismg, grazed.

Ulrich Unstoppable smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Dietrich Mindblot came out for a cup and was badly wounded. A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Ulrich Unstoppable shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Albin Orion, was gravely wounded.
Ulrich checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
peterpederpeter: Nils Peterpederpe arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in U-F12 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Nils Peterpederpe watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Nils Peterpederpe shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Nils Peterpederpe kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

The men at U-F12 heard Nils Peterpederpe call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Isidor "Rabbit" Png of the Hegemony (@sevr.png). A single shot at U-F12. Nils Peterpederpe sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Isidor "Rabbit" Png of the Hegemony (@sevr.png).
Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe put a tin whistle beside the bunk. Someone who had known Nils Peterpederpe helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe read a theatre review while peeling supper.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe waited for that to change. When it did, Benedikt Justmusl was badly wounded.

Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Zeno "Doc" Calmherculie crossed it, Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe fired. Zeno "Doc" Calmherculie was grazed. Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe was hit hard at the Brickworks. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin.

Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe. Nobody pretends that is not how it works.
The bleeding has stopped. Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen.
Leopold walked back up the communication trench to U-F12, slowly, looking at everything as if for the first time.
razziel.g: The old hands of N-F10 have been here since Day 1. Ivo Razziel has been here since Day 12. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh of the Concord and Ivo Razziel of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Bone Quarry for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Machine-gun fire swept N-F10. Ivo Razziel took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Konrad "Spark" Raven of the Concord (@recon.raven14).
Ivo Razziel spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Ivo Razziel. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Another member of the House of Razziel reached the line: Konrad Razziel. He asked where Ivo Razziel had slept, then chose a different corner.
Konrad Razziel found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Konrad hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
s1mply_ren: Arno Ren came up on Day 11 carrying news from Kesselby. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Arno Ren helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Arno Ren fired at a movement across the wire at U-F6. The man went down: Henrik "Ghost" Hero, grazed.
Arno Ren found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Arno Ren dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
A clear shot from U-F6. Arno Ren grazed Leopold "Tin" Guy and slid back down below the parapet.
The gun crews at U-F6 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Pavel Hite was grazed.
Arno Ren drew the street leading to Kesselby. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
Arno fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F6. Tobias Guy was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
texan_rebel01: By the time Isidor Rebel reached W-F7, the war was 17 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Isidor fixed the strap on Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
zdawg_44: Henrik Zdawg arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a key to a house that is no longer there and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Night raid. Henrik Zdawg crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Henrik Zdawg. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C9 changed before the cheering ended. Henrik Zdawg shouldered another load.

Henrik Zdawg kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. Henrik Zdawg got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 691. The men who came later will ask about it. Henrik Zdawg walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Henrik Zdawg fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-C9. Florian "Doc" Guyy was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
A shell landed close to R-C9. When the dust settled Henrik Zdawg was still there, holding a key to a house that is no longer there, laughing without sound.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Henrik Zdawg tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-C9 is up.
Henrik Zdawg tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
The flare went up just as Henrik Zdawg reached the Concord parapet. Henrik Zdawg jumped down first. Hugo Rock was the man waiting there, and Hugo Rock fell. (@rotrek_rock)
Henrik Zdawg laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
Henrik wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
zidane_mcnamara: In Tannenfeld, Edmund Mcnamara was a clockmaker. In S-S7, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a clockmaker again.

Edmund Mcnamara found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close. Edmund Mcnamara bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Edmund Mcnamara was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.'

Edmund Mcnamara's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara fired at a movement across the wire at S-S7. The man went down: Bastian Fly, grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Edmund Mcnamara kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

An officer asked who was writing the menus. Edmund Mcnamara admitted it and waited. The officer asked for a copy to send home. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Edmund Mcnamara is number 420. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Edmund Mcnamara helped stack spare sandbags at S-S7. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A Jack Russell terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Edmund Mcnamara. Edmund Mcnamara gave it a name: Spot.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon stood up to sing louder, and Edmund Mcnamara fired. Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon was grazed. The singing stopped. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Edmund Mcnamara shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon, was badly wounded. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara retired the menu after running out of grand names for turnips. The final card reads 'The Usual', underlined twice. A soldier from another squad offered three cigarettes for Spot. Edmund Mcnamara said no. The dog is not for sale. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Lucien Somehowballi was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Edmund Mcnamara. Edmund Mcnamara read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fresh from training, Edmund Mcnamara still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Otto Sonofadeadme, grazed. Edmund Mcnamara fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Hugo Somehowballi was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Edmund fired back. Isidor Jimmysparrow was grazed. A letter came for Edmund from a little town he had not seen in a year. Inside was a newspaper clipping about the harvest.
